title: Asking About a Missing Transcript Entry

prompt.scenario: You recently completed an intensive summer course in organic chemistry, but the final grade does not appear on your unofficial academic transcript. You need an updated record to apply for a hospital research internship by this Friday. Write an email to the registrar coordinator, Ms. Delaney.
requirements: Explain the missing summer course grade on your academic transcript record.
Emphasize your upcoming internship application deadline this Friday.
Request an expedited record update or a provisional grade confirmation letter.

modelEssay:
Dear Ms. Delaney,

I am writing to inquire about a missing course entry on my academic transcript record.

I successfully completed Chemistry 220 (Organic Chemistry) during the second summer session, earning a final grade of A-. However, when I checked my unofficial transcript on the student portal this morning, the course was not listed under my completed credits. Because I am submitting an application for a competitive clinical research internship this Friday, I need an official record demonstrating that I fulfilled this chemistry prerequisite. Could your office verify the instructor's grade submission and update my transcript? If the processing takes several days, would it be possible to issue a provisional letter confirming my enrollment and grade? Thank you for your assistance.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

title: Seeking a Different Observation Site

prompt.scenario: You are enrolled in Professor Emerson's education practicum. The elementary school where you were assigned to complete your classroom observation hours has suddenly closed to visitors due to heating system repairs. Write an email to Professor Emerson.
requirements: Explain why your assigned elementary school has canceled visitor access.
Specify the number of observation hours you still need to fulfill before midterms.
Request reassignment to another partner school or an approved alternative arrangement.

modelEssay:
Dear Professor Emerson,

I am writing to inform you of an unexpected placement problem regarding my fieldwork observation hours for Education 305.

Yesterday, the principal at Oakridge Elementary School notified me that all visitor appointments are canceled for the next three weeks due to emergency boiler repairs. Because I still need to complete ten observation hours before the midterm deadline, waiting for the school to reopen would delay my field analysis report significantly. Could you please reassign me to another partner school in the district with available mentor teachers? I am available any weekday morning and would be happy to travel to a different campus immediately. Thank you for your guidance and help with this placement.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

title: Requesting an Extension for a Map Project

prompt.scenario: You are a student in Dr. Franco's geographic information systems (GIS) course. The university geospatial data server crashed during scheduled lab hours, preventing your group from downloading topographic layers for your digital watershed map. Write an email to Dr. Franco.
requirements: Explain how the geospatial server crash disrupted your group's map compilation.
Describe the data analysis work your team has already completed offline.
Request a two-day submission extension until Friday to finalize the spatial layers.

modelEssay:
Dear Dr. Franco,

I am writing on behalf of our lab group to request a brief extension on our digital watershed mapping assignment, currently due this Wednesday.

While working in the computer lab yesterday afternoon, the university GIS server experienced an outage that lasted over four hours, displaying a database connection timeout. Consequently, our team could not download the required digital elevation model (DEM) and contour shapefiles. We have already completed our attribute tables and formatted the map layout templates offline. Could our group submit the final interactive map on Friday afternoon instead? This two-day extension will allow us to download the server layers and render the spatial data properly. Thank you for your understanding and support.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

title: Asking About a Student Conference Grant

prompt.scenario: You are an undergraduate researcher whose environmental engineering paper was accepted for a poster presentation at a regional conference in Chicago. Travel costs are beyond your personal budget. Write an email to the student research grant officer, Ms. Greene.
requirements: Explain your conference presentation acceptance and why attending is valuable.
Outline the estimated travel expenses for transportation and student registration.
Inquire about undergraduate travel award deadlines and required application forms.

modelEssay:
Dear Ms. Greene,

I am writing to inquire about undergraduate travel funding opportunities supported by the Office of Student Research.

My abstract on microplastic filtration systems has just been accepted for a poster presentation at the Midwest Environmental Engineering Conference in Chicago next month. Presenting my undergraduate findings to professional researchers will be an invaluable academic opportunity. However, traveling from out of state requires purchasing round-trip train tickets and paying the student conference registration fee, which exceeds my personal budget. Does your office offer travel grants for student presenters? If funding is available, could you please provide the application guidelines and submission deadline? I have my acceptance letter and faculty endorsement ready to submit. Thank you very much for your time and guidance.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

title: Requesting a Library Study Room Change

prompt.scenario: Your senior seminar team reserved Study Room 204 in the main library to rehearse your capstone slide deck. Upon entering the room, you discovered that the digital display projector has a broken HDMI input and will not power on. Write an email to the library facilities manager, Mr. Hale.
requirements: Explain the projector hardware failure in your reserved study room.

modelEssay:
Dear Mr. Hale,

I am writing to report an equipment failure in Group Study Room 204 and request an immediate room reassignment for our project team.

Our group reserved this room from 2:00 to 4:00 PM today to rehearse our senior capstone presentation. However, the wall-mounted digital projector will not power on, and the primary HDMI cable connector is severely bent and loose. Because our final presentation takes place tomorrow morning, seeing our slide transitions and embedded video demonstrations on a large display is essential for timing our talk accurately. Could library staff transfer our reservation to another available study room with a working monitor on the second or third floor? We appreciate your prompt assistance with this matter.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

title: Seeking Advice on a Minor

prompt.scenario: You are a second-year journalism major considering adding an academic minor in data science to pursue investigative reporting. You want to ensure the additional coursework fits into your four-year graduation timeline. Write an email to the faculty advisor, Professor Ingram.
requirements: Describe your interest in combining investigative journalism with data analytics.
Ask how the minor requirements might integrate with your remaining elective credits.
Request an advising appointment during office hours to review your academic plan.

modelEssay:
Dear Professor Ingram,

I am writing to seek your academic advice regarding declaring a minor in Data Science alongside my Journalism major.

My long-term career ambition is to pursue investigative data reporting, where extracting and visualizing statistical information from public datasets is crucial. After reviewing the course catalog, I noticed that the minor requires eighteen credits, including courses in Python programming and applied regression. Before submitting a formal minor declaration form, I want to ensure that these prerequisites can be completed within my remaining elective slots without delaying my scheduled graduation. Would you be available for a fifteen-minute advising meeting next Tuesday or Wednesday afternoon? I have mapped out my four-year course plan for your review. Thank you for your mentorship and guidance.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

title: Requesting a Different Library Pickup Location

prompt.scenario: You ordered a rare academic monograph through interlibrary loan. The system automatically assigned pickup to the Downtown Law Campus library, but all your daily classes and research activities take place at North Campus. Write an email to the interlibrary loan officer, Ms. Javed.
requirements: Explain the inconvenient pickup location assigned by the automated interlibrary portal.

modelEssay:
Dear Ms. Javed,

I am writing to request a pickup location transfer for an interlibrary loan book that arrived yesterday.

My requested monograph, "Urban Water Infrastructure Policy" (Request ID: #IL-4921), is currently held at the Downtown Law Library. However, all my classes, laboratories, and dormitory housing are located eight miles away on the North Campus. Traveling downtown between lectures is difficult with my current course schedule, and because the lending library allows only a two-week loan period without renewals, I want to begin reading as soon as possible. Could you please transfer this volume via the campus courier service to the North Science Library circulation desk? I would be glad to collect it there once notified. Thank you for your assistance.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

title: Asking to Join a Workshop Waitlist

requirements: Explain your upcoming honors thesis literature review and eagerness to attend.

modelEssay:
Dear Mr. Keane,

I am writing to inquire about attending your upcoming Writing Center workshop, "Synthesizing Sources for Literature Reviews," scheduled for this Thursday afternoon.

As a junior beginning my honors psychology thesis, I am currently structuring my first comprehensive literature review. I was eager to participate in your session, but the registration portal indicates that the workshop is completely full. Would it be possible to add my name to a cancellation waitlist in case an enrolled student withdraws? Alternatively, if the room has standing space, would you permit me to quietly audit the presentation? If capacity cannot accommodate additional attendees, I would be extremely grateful if you could share the digital slides and handout templates. Thank you for supporting student research.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

title: Seeking a Replacement Field Notebook

Dear Dr. Lin,

Could you please let me know where I can purchase an approved replacement rite-in-the-rain notebook on campus? Furthermore, would you prefer that I transcribe my notes into the new book or submit a typed summary alongside the photos? Thank you for your guidance.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

Because our research projects incorporate ethnographic interviews, archival documents, and academic monographs, I want to ensure my citations adhere strictly to your grading criteria. Could you please confirm which reference system we should adopt for the final submission? Clarifying this now will allow our class to format footnotes and bibliographies accurately before Friday's deadline. Thank you for your time.

title: Asking About Bicycle Storage

prompt.scenario: You commute to campus by bicycle each day to work in the natural sciences research building. The single outdoor bicycle rack outside the hall is consistently overcrowded by 8:30 AM, forcing students to lock bikes to disability handrails. Write an email to the campus facilities director, Ms. North.
requirements: Describe the severe shortage of bicycle parking outside the science building.
Explain how bicycles locked to railings create accessibility and safety hazards.
Suggest installing additional bike racks or providing indoor basement storage.

modelEssay:
Dear Ms. North,

I am writing to report a bicycle parking shortage outside the Natural Sciences Building and to propose a practical solution.

The single bike rack outside the main entrance is consistently filled to capacity before 8:30 AM every morning. Because over fifty student researchers work in the laboratories throughout the day, cyclists frequently lock their bicycles to the exterior wheelchair ramp handrails and emergency exit gates. This practice severely obstructs pathway access for students with physical disabilities and creates a serious safety hazard during fire evacuations. Could facilities management install a secondary bike shelter near the plaza? Alternatively, could the department open the unused basement storage room for commuter bikes? Thank you for considering this campus improvement.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

title: Requesting a Change in Project Materials

prompt.scenario: You are a student in Dr. Olson's industrial product design studio. modelEssay:
Dear Dr. Olson,

I am writing to request permission to substitute a raw material for our midterm furniture design prototype, due next Thursday.

Our team attempted to purchase the specified quarter-inch Baltic birch plywood yesterday, but the campus woodshop and regional lumber suppliers confirmed that the material is backordered nationwide until late next month. To keep our construction on schedule, we identified an in-stock furniture-grade maple plywood with identical structural thickness, tensile strength, and finishing quality. Using this substitute will allow our group to begin laser-cutting tomorrow without compromising design stability or aesthetic appearance. Could you please confirm whether this material substitution is acceptable under the studio grading rubric? I have attached the manufacturer's technical spec sheet. Thank you for your guidance.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

title: Seeking Permission to Audit a Lecture

modelEssay:
Dear Professor Price,

I am writing to inquire whether I might be permitted to informally audit your graduate seminar, Astrophysics 502 (Galaxy Formation and Evolution), next spring.

I would love to attend the weekly lectures to expand my foundational knowledge and learn about recent James Webb Space Telescope discoveries. I would sit quietly in the back and would not require grading on problem sets or papers. Would you be open to welcoming an undergraduate auditor? Thank you very much for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

modelEssay:
Dear Dr. Zaman,

I am writing to request guidance regarding chemical waste protocols for our ongoing analytical extraction experiment.

Today, our team successfully synthesized a solvent mixture containing both chlorinated hydrocarbons and dilute organic acids. While reviewing the lab's Environmental Health and Safety manual, I noted that halogenated and acidic wastes must never be combined in standard drums to prevent hazardous exothermal reactions. Because our extraction generates approximately three liters of this specific mixture, we do not want to risk improper disposal in the regular waste carboys. Could you please advise us on the approved neutralization procedure, or should we prepare a specially labeled glass container for this compound? We have sealed the solvent flasks safely in the fume hood until we receive your instructions. Thank you for your guidance.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

title: Requesting a Lab Rotation Change

Dear Dr. Lopez,

I am writing to respectfully request an adjustment to my laboratory rotation assignment for the upcoming winter module.

I was recently assigned to Rotation 2 in Biomolecular Separation. However, having worked as an undergraduate research assistant for two years, I have already mastered PCR amplification and agarose gel electrophoresis. Because the primary objective of rotations is broadening experimental competencies, repeating this methodology will not advance my doctoral training. I am eager to gain practical skills in confocal fluorescence microscopy and live-cell imaging, which are central to my proposed dissertation topic. I spoke informally with Dr. Chen, and she confirmed that her imaging lab has an open workstation available. Could you please approve my transfer to Dr. Chen's rotation? Thank you very much for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

Dear Mr. Mason,

I am writing to report a serious service inconsistency regarding the late-night campus safety shuttle and to raise a safety concern on behalf of student researchers.

On both Monday and Wednesday nights, the scheduled 10:15 PM shuttle failed to arrive at the Bio-Agricultural Research Station. This facility is located nearly two miles from the main campus center along unlit country roads without pedestrian sidewalks. Several student lab assistants were left stranded after dark in sub-freezing temperatures, unable to reach the main residence halls safely without calling expensive rideshares. Has this evening route been suspended or permanently rescheduled? Could your office ensure that scheduled late-night runs are monitored reliably, or provide an on-demand campus security escort service when shuttles are delayed? Thank you for prioritizing student safety.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

Dear Dr. Walsh,

Although we have set up our preliminary seedling trays in the student teaching lab, observing the commercial-grade photoperiod chambers and automated misting systems in the main greenhouse would provide crucial technical insights for calibrating our environmental controls. We will strictly follow all biosecurity protocols, including wearing sanitized lab coats and boot covers to prevent pest contamination. Would you or a greenhouse technician have twenty minutes to guide us through the climate-controlled rooms? Thank you very much for your time.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

title: Seeking Permission to Translate a Survey

prompt.scenario: You are conducting an undergraduate research survey on community public transit satisfaction in Dr. York's urban sociology class. modelEssay:
Dear Dr. York,

I am writing to seek your approval for a methodological addition to our urban transit survey project.

Our team is surveying neighborhood riders about bus stop safety and scheduling frequency along the Westside corridor. While piloting our questions, we discovered that over forty percent of daily transit riders in this neighborhood are native Spanish speakers with limited English proficiency. To ensure our research represents the community authentically, we would like to offer a bilingual survey version. I have translated the questionnaire and consent script into Spanish, and a certified bilingual classmate in the Hispanic Studies department has independently back-translated the text to verify terminological accuracy. Could you review our bilingual draft and confirm whether this approach satisfies institutional ethics standards? I have attached both language versions for your review. Thank you for your guidance.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

title: Seeking Guidance on an Ethics Form

modelEssay:
Dear Dr. Calder,

I am writing to seek your guidance regarding the ethical review requirements for an upcoming undergraduate research project in Environmental Sociology.

My research team is investigating student commuting behaviors and campus carbon footprints. We have designed a ten-question digital questionnaire asking participants about public transit usage, bicycle routes, and vehicle parking habits. The survey collects no names, IP addresses, student identification numbers, or sensitive demographic information, ensuring complete participant anonymity. Furthermore, our sample involves exclusively consenting adult university students and presents no physical or psychological risk. Before we distribute the questionnaire next month, could you please advise whether this student project qualifies for an Institutional Review Board (IRB) exempt determination? Please let me know which application forms our faculty advisor should endorse. Thank you for your expertise and time.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

Hi Celia,

title: Giving Feedback on a Club Workshop

modelEssay:
Hi Daniel,

I wanted to send a quick note to congratulate you on hosting such an engaging beginner photography workshop yesterday evening!

Your explanations of manual aperture control and lighting ratios were incredibly clear, and the sample portrait comparisons really helped de-mystify studio strobe settings for new members. The only challenge was the room capacity; with over thirty students packed into Studio B, attendees in the back rows could not clearly see the softbox modifiers or model posing adjustments. For our next workshop on portrait editing, could the club consider booking a larger tiered classroom with a ceiling projector? That way, you could tether your camera to the big screen so everyone can watch the live camera adjustments comfortably. Thanks again for organizing a fantastic event.

Best,
Alex

title: Asking About a Missed Club Trip

prompt.scenario: You signed up for the Outdoor Recreation Club's weekend kayaking excursion. The departure time was moved from 8:00 AM to 7:00 AM via a last-minute group chat message that you did not see, causing you to miss the bus. Write an email to the club trip leader, Elena.
requirements: Explain that you arrived at the original 8:00 AM meeting time after missing the chat update.

modelEssay:
Hi Elena,

I am writing to follow up on this morning's kayaking excursion to Silver Lake.

I arrived at the student recreation bus circle at 7:50 AM with my gear, only to discover that the charter bus had departed at 7:00 AM. When I checked my phone afterward, I saw that the departure time had been moved up late last night via an informal group chat thread that I unfortunately missed while studying. I know coordinating transportation for thirty students is very complex and weather conditions often force early departures. For future trips, could the club consider sending official schedule changes through the campus listserv email in addition to chat apps? That would ensure critical announcements reach all participants reliably. I hope everyone had a safe and enjoyable paddle today!

Best,
Alex

title: Organizing a Welcome Dinner

Hi Farid,

Hi Gina,

For our next team celebration, perhaps we could select a cafe closer to campus, or place pre-orders online in the morning so our food is ready upon arrival? Dear Marcus,

Sincerely,

Dear Paula,

title: Asking to Attend a Conference

prompt.scenario: You are an undergraduate researcher in Dr. Delgado's coastal marine ecology laboratory. You have been selected to attend the State Marine Conservation Symposium this Friday, which coincides with your weekly laboratory duties. Write an email to Dr. Delgado requesting permission to attend.

modelEssay:
Dear Dr. Delgado,

I am writing to respectfully request permission to attend the State Marine Conservation Symposium this coming Friday, October 17th.

The symposium features panels on wetland restoration and tidal erosion modeling that directly intersect with my undergraduate honors thesis on estuarine sedimentation. Attending these presentations will allow me to network with regional conservation specialists and learn about emerging field methodology. To ensure my lab responsibilities are fulfilled, I worked ahead and pre-labeled all filtration racks yesterday. Furthermore, my lab partner Jordan has graciously agreed to run our Friday afternoon water sample titrations, and I will cover his maintenance duties next week. Would you approve my absence from the laboratory on Friday? I would be thrilled to give a brief five-minute summary of the conference findings at our next lab meeting. Thank you for your guidance.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

Dear Professor Everett,

I am writing to formally request approval for a credit overload for the upcoming spring semester.

However, I wish to enroll in twenty credits in order to take Advanced Geographic Information Systems (ENV 410) alongside my required environmental science core. Because ENV 410 is taught on a biennial rotation, this spring is the only opportunity for me to take the course before I graduate next year. Mastering advanced spatial analysis is essential for my planned career in environmental consulting. I have maintained a cumulative 3.82 GPA while balancing lab assistantships, demonstrating my ability to handle rigorous academic workloads successfully. Could you please approve my registration overload petition form? I have completed my section and attached the digital waiver for your signature. Thank you for your support.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

Before making a final decision ahead of Friday's course withdrawal deadline, I want to seek your professional advice regarding how withdrawing might affect my major sequence and whether taking the course during summer session would be advisable. Dear Dr. Gupta,

As an aspiring entomologist, I am fascinated by behavioral adaptations in anthropogenically altered environments. Last semester, I earned an A in Invertebrate Zoology and completed a field methods practicum where I learned sweep-netting, insect specimen pinning, and statistical data modeling in R. I am diligent, comfortable conducting evening fieldwork, and able to commit eight hours weekly. Are there openings for undergraduate assistants on this project? If so, I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my technical skills could support your field trials. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,

title: Asking for Office Hours Advice

prompt.scenario: You are drafting an essay on urban political geography for Professor Li's seminar. You have completed the research readings but are struggling to connect two competing theories: David Harvey's capital accumulation model and Saskia Sassen's global cities framework. Write an email to Professor Li requesting a consultation.
requirements: Explain your essay topic and your difficulty synthesizing the two urban spatial theories.

modelEssay:
Dear Professor Li,

I am writing to ask whether I might meet with you for fifteen minutes during office hours to discuss the conceptual framework of my term essay.

My paper examines the spatial restructuring of post-industrial waterfront districts. While I have thoroughly outlined the historical case studies, I am struggling to synthesize our two core theoretical readings: David Harvey's spatial fix model of capital accumulation and Saskia Sassen's global city hypothesis. Both scholars analyze urban centralization, but I am finding it difficult to reconcile their differing perspectives on cross-border financial circuits without making my thesis argument contradictory. I have drafted a two-page comparative matrix outlining their points of convergence and tension. Would you have fifteen minutes available this Wednesday afternoon to help me refine my theoretical bridge? I would be grateful for your intellectual guidance. Thank you very much.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

title: Requesting a Different Exam Slot

requirements: Explain the direct scheduling conflict between your two required final examinations.

modelEssay:
Dear Dr. Morales,

I am writing to bring a direct final examination scheduling conflict to your attention and to request an alternate exam time.

According to the official exam matrix published yesterday by the registrar, my final exam for Physical Chemistry 301 is scheduled for Thursday, December 11th, from 2:00 to 5:00 PM. However, my required final for Econometrics 320 has been placed in that exact same three-hour timeslot. University academic policy explicitly states that students with concurrent exam conflicts are entitled to an alternate sitting arranged by the departments. I checked with the economics department, but their instructor has only a single exam sitting. Would it be possible for me to sit for your physical chemistry exam during your morning testing section at 9:00 AM on Thursday, or proctored through the university testing center on Friday? Thank you for your guidance and assistance.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

title: Following Up After a Seminar

Dear Dr. Nguyen,

I am writing to thank you for your fascinating presentation yesterday afternoon on CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing in crop resilience during our department's guest seminar series.

Your explanation of using multiplex base editing to enhance drought-tolerance pathways in cereal grains was profoundly inspiring. I am currently formulating my senior undergraduate honors thesis proposal on genetic adaptations in drought-stressed legumes. Hearing your insights regarding off-target mutation mitigations helped clarify several methodological hurdles I had been wrestling with in our laboratory literature review. Could you recommend one or two seminal review articles or recent publications from your laboratory that focus on non-viral ribonucleoprotein delivery vectors in plant tissues? Reading your recommended papers will help me construct a much stronger experimental methodology for my thesis proposal. Thank you very much for sharing your groundbreaking research with our university community.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

• Hậu quả môi trường: Rác tái chế dính dầu mỡ buộc cả xe rác phải chở ra bãi chôn lấp rác thải chôn bỏ.
• Giải pháp hình ảnh: Đề xuất dán poster ảnh màu ngang tầm mắt; tình nguyện viên sẵn sàng đi dán giúp.

title: Reporting a Bicycle Theft Concern

prompt.scenario: You commute to campus by bicycle and park at the east entrance bike racks of Juniper Hall. Over the past three nights, two student bicycles had their steel U-locks severed with bolt cutters, and another lock was visibly damaged. Write an email to the campus public safety coordinator, Ms. Upton.
requirements: Report the severed bicycle locks and recent bike thefts at the Juniper Hall east racks.

modelEssay:
Dear Ms. Upton,

I am writing to report an escalating property theft issue and security concern outside Juniper Residence Hall.

Over the past three nights, two heavy-duty steel U-locks were severed with bolt cutters at the east entrance bicycle racks, and two student commuter bicycles were stolen. This morning, a neighbor discovered deep cut marks on his own cable lock, indicating that thieves are repeatedly targeting this specific area under cover of darkness. Because dozens of students rely on bicycles to travel between campus laboratories and evening classes, residents are increasingly anxious about leaving their bikes parked overnight. Could campus police increase nighttime foot and vehicle patrols near the Juniper east walkway? Additionally, would public safety consider installing an overhead surveillance camera or motion-sensor floodlight above the bike racks? Thank you for protecting student safety and property.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

title: Requesting a Kitchen Cleaning Plan

prompt.scenario: You live on the fourth floor of Oak Hall. The communal kitchen has repeatedly been left with unwashed frying pans, food splatters across the stovetop, and uncovered leftovers on countertops over the weekend. Write an email to your floor Resident Advisor, Jordan.
requirements: Describe the recurring unsanitary conditions and unwashed cookware left in the shared kitchen.
Explain how the mess attracts pests and prevents other residents from cooking meals.

modelEssay:
Hi Jordan,

I am writing to raise a sanitation concern regarding our fourth-floor communal kitchen in Oak Hall and to suggest a collaborative solution.

Throughout the past two weekends, several residents have repeatedly left greasy frying pans in the sinks, dried sauce splatters across the stovetops, and uncovered food containers on the countertops overnight. The resulting odor has become noticeable down the hall, and yesterday morning several residents observed ants near the food preparation area. In addition, the cluttered counters make it difficult for other students to prepare their daily meals comfortably. Could we implement a rotating nightly cleaning checklist where residents sign off on wiping down surfaces? Furthermore, could you dedicate ten minutes at our upcoming Sunday floor meeting to establish clear community expectations regarding kitchen cleanliness? I would be glad to help draft the checklist. Thank you for your leadership.

Best,
Alex

• Thực trạng nhếch nhác: Chảo mỡ, vết sốt vương vãi trên bếp, đồ ăn hở qua đêm bắt đầu thu hút kiến bọ.
• Ảnh hưởng chung: Mùi hôi lan ra hành lang, mặt bếp bừa bãi khiến người khác không nấu ăn được.

title: Asking About a Roommate Swap

prompt.scenario: You are a second-year resident in Maple Hall. Your assigned roommate works an overnight hospital nursing shift and returns to the room at 4:30 AM, while you have 8:00 AM chemistry lectures every morning. Despite using sleep masks and earplugs, your conflicting sleep schedules leave both of you exhausted. Write an email to the residential life coordinator, Ms. Vega.
requirements: Explain the severe sleep disruption caused by opposing overnight work and early morning class schedules.
Describe the practical compromises both roommates have already attempted (sleep masks, quiet hours, desk lamps).
Inquire about room transfer policies or mutual swap options with other night-shift students.

modelEssay:
Dear Ms. Vega,

I am writing to respectfully request advice regarding a room transfer due to an unavoidable schedule incompatibility in Maple Hall, Room 218.

My roommate and I get along very well personally, but our daily schedules are completely inverted. He works an overnight patient-care shift at the hospital and returns at 4:30 AM to cook and get ready for bed, while I have mandatory 8:00 AM chemistry lectures every weekday. Over the past month, we have tried establishing strict quiet rules, utilizing low-wattage desk lamps, and wearing earplugs and sleep masks, but the door latches and necessary movement continue to wake us up. As a result, both of us are experiencing chronic exhaustion that affects our academic performance. Could you explain the procedure for a mutual room swap? Perhaps there is another resident working nocturnal shifts who would be an ideal match. Thank you for your guidance.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

• Đã thử đủ cách: Dùng đèn bàn nhỏ, bịt tai, đeo che mắt nhưng vẫn mất ngủ triền miên gây ảnh hưởng học tập.
• Giải pháp hợp lý: Hỏi thủ tục đổi phòng hoặc ghép với một bạn khác cũng làm ca đêm.

title: Correcting a Course Registration Error

prompt.scenario: You registered for your upcoming spring semester classes. When checking your student billing account, you discovered that Biology 210 (Cell Biology) was duplicated, appearing twice on your schedule and billing you for twenty-two credits instead of sixteen. Write an email to the academic registrar specialist, Ms. Alvarez.
requirements: Explain the duplicate enrollment error for Biology 210 displayed on your schedule portal.
Point out that the duplicate registration erroneously inflates your tuition bill and exceeds the credit limit.
Request that the duplicate course entry be purged immediately before the tuition billing deadline.

modelEssay:
Dear Ms. Alvarez,

I am writing to report a technical registration error on my student portal account and to request an administrative correction.

While reviewing my confirmed spring semester schedule this morning, I noticed that Biology 210 (Cell Biology, Section 02) is duplicated on my course roster. Although I registered for the lecture only once, the system created two identical four-credit entries with matching laboratory sections. Consequently, my registered total currently stands at twenty-two credit hours instead of sixteen, triggering an automated overload tuition surcharge on my bursar bill. Because tuition payments must be settled by this Friday, I want to resolve this billing inflation before financial aid funds are disbursed. Could your office please purge the duplicate Biology 210 enrollment and issue an updated billing statement? I have attached a screenshot of my registration confirmation. Thank you for your assistance.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

Could you please check your back-end document queue to verify whether my uploaded PDF files were received intact? If the portal experienced an upload error, I can hand-deliver physical paper copies to your office in Founders Hall this afternoon. Thank you for helping me secure my financial aid.

Because national medical school verification services (AMCAS) perform strict identity cross-referencing against state driver's licenses and passports, any discrepancy between my transcript and government documents will delay my application processing. Could you please advise me on the procedure for updating my legal name in the student information database? title: Proposing a Campus Swap Event

Dear Mr. Ruiz,

I am writing on behalf of the Student Sustainability Coalition to propose hosting an eco-friendly campus event, the "Midterm Textbook and School Supply Swap."

Our event will provide a centralized exchange where students can donate surplus supplies and pick up needed study materials entirely free of charge, saving students money and reducing landfill waste. We envision setting up six student tables in the Student Union atrium on Wednesday, October 29th, from 11:00 AM to 3:00 PM. Our student officers will staff the tables continuously, organize incoming items, and transport all remaining donations to the local youth shelter afterward. Could you please advise us on the official facility reservation and safety approval process for this event? Thank you for supporting student sustainability initiatives.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

title: Giving Advice to a New Student

prompt.scenario: Your high school friend Ema is starting her first semester at your university. She feels overwhelmed by the expensive $600 textbook bill at the bookstore and asked for money-saving tips. Write an email to Ema sharing practical textbook options.

modelEssay:
Dear Ema,

Welcome to university life! I was so excited to hear you are moving into the dorms this week.

Whatever you do, please do not purchase brand-new textbooks at the campus bookstore! Spending six hundred dollars upfront is completely unnecessary. For required readings, check the university library catalog first; professors place physical copies of almost every core textbook on two-hour course reserve behind the circulation desk, which you can scan for free. For books you need all semester, renting digital e-books through Chegg or buying secondhand copies through our university student book exchange group is often seventy percent cheaper. If you want, send me your course syllabi, and we can grab lunch this Saturday to search online databases together and find free open-access PDFs. You will save hundreds of dollars! Let me know if that sounds helpful.

Best,
Alex

Dear Ms. Arora,

I would love to contribute an article about our weekend tutoring program at the Riverside Community Center. Liam Evans

modelEssay:
Dear Mr. Bennett,

Thank you for consistently keeping our campus community informed through the weekly newsletter. I am writing regarding a brief scheduling detail in yesterday's entertainment section.

The newsletter states that Friday's annual spring jazz concert will begin at 8:00 PM. However, our music department booking and all printed ticket confirmations clearly specify a 6:30 PM start time, with doors opening at 6:00 PM. We are concerned that attendees relying on the published article might miss the first half of the performance.

Sincerely,
Olivia Taylor

Dear Mr. Das,

title: Raising a Safety Concern at a Club Event
prompt:
During yesterday evening's international cultural festival in the student union ballroom, an uncovered heavy extension cord running across the primary doorway caused multiple people to trip.

modelEssay:
Dear Ms. Karim,

I want to congratulate you on organizing an outstanding cultural festival yesterday evening. The performances and food showcases were truly memorable.

I am writing to share a safety observation from the event. Near the main entrance to the ballroom, a thick black power cable was stretched directly across the walkway without any protective cover. Because lighting in that corner was dimmed, I noticed several visitors trip over the cord, and one student nearly dropped a heavy beverage tray.

To prevent potential falls or injuries at future gatherings, could we utilize rubber cable ramps or tape the cords securely along the perimeter walls? Thank you for your attention to keeping our campus events safe.

Sincerely,
Jason Miller

Over the past month, I have compiled five class projects into an online portfolio, focusing on responsive web interfaces and user research findings. Because this is my first formal design application, I want to ensure that my case study storytelling and layout visual hierarchy effectively highlight my problem-solving process.

Would you have ten or fifteen minutes during your office hours this Wednesday to look over my website link? I would greatly value your perspective before submitting my final application. Thank you very much for your time.

Sincerely,
Elena Rostova

title: Asking About a Paid Student Job
prompt:
The university international student center posted an opening for a paid student desk assistant, but the listing did not specify the required weekly hours or daily shifts.

Write an email to the hiring manager, Mr. Benson. In your email, you should:
- state your interest in the student desk assistant position and how you learned about it
- ask about weekly hour commitments, shift flexibility around classes, and main duties
- inquire about the application process and required documents such as resumes or references
modelEssay:
Dear Mr. Benson,

I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to express my strong interest in the Student Desk Assistant opening posted on the campus job board yesterday.

Having participated in several international student orientation events last semester, I would love to support incoming students with campus resources and front-desk reception. Because the job advertisement did not include scheduling details, could you kindly clarify the expected weekly hours? Specifically, I would appreciate knowing if student employees can arrange shifts around morning and afternoon lecture schedules.

Lastly, could you confirm what application materials are required and what the submission deadline is? I have updated my resume and would be delighted to submit it. Thank you for your time and assistance.

Best regards,
Jordan Lee
